info.title: Static_PIM_Mroute
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address_family.description: Address family of this static multicast route.

group_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_PIM_Mroute](#/Static_PIM_Mroute)
The multicast group address of the traffic stream.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_PIM_Mroute](#/Static_PIM_Mroute)
The upstream [Port](#/Port) on which the multicast traffic stream is expected to be received.

source_address.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_PIM_Mroute](#/Static_PIM_Mroute)
The source IP address of the multicast traffic stream or `any`. `any`: Indicates any source address.

static_pim_nexthops.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_PIM_Nexthop](#/Static_PIM_Nexthop)
The outgoing list of [Static_PIM_Nexthop](#/Static_PIM_Nexthop)s associated with this route entry.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_PIM_Mroute](#/Static_PIM_Mroute)
VRF that the multicast route is associated with.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
